title: What Should We Upgrade?
description: NetBreak is a TCP/UDP port scanner tool released on GitHub by the 5evenTeam, designed for authorized network reconnaissance. It features multiple front ends (terminal UI, desktop app, and CLI) and supports service/version detection and OS guessing heuristics. The tool is intended for legitimate scanning purposes and does not represent a vulnerability or active threat by itself. No security vulnerabilities or exploits are reported in the provided information.

references.title: Reddit Discussion: What Should We Upgrade?

aiSummary: NetBreak is an open-source network scanning tool that performs TCP connect and UDP scans with service and version detection capabilities. It supports multiple user interfaces and scan engines implemented in Python, Go, and C++. The tool is designed for authorized use and includes features such as banner grabbing and OS heuristics. There is no indication of any security flaw, vulnerability, or exploit associated with NetBreak in the provided data.
aiImpact: No direct security impact or vulnerability is described. NetBreak is a legitimate network reconnaissance tool without reported security issues or exploits in the wild.
